properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-09-07: "let's go with build the whole leg: the constructor, the edges read by something, and the two detectors that ask a human about an unchecked compliance or an open violation."

DISTINCT FROM THE TWO NODES THE GUARD SURFACED, BY ROLE. `dec:idea-the-environment-compliance-layer-was-designed-and-never-built` is the DELIBERATION — the open question and its five options. `decision:vocab:environment` is the PARKING RULING, and its id is load-bearing because vocabulary_coverage looks the domain's park_with up by it. This is a THIRD act: the LIFT. Folding it into either would lose something — into the deliberation, that a decision was taken; into the parking, that the parking ended and why.

THE CONDITION THE PARKING NAMED WAS MET, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS NOT A REVERSAL. Its own words: a parked domain a user later asks for becomes a build with nothing undone. On 2026-09-07 the contract-and-standards brainstorm named "building codes" and "standards", both values in this type's own rule_type enum written months earlier, and the ruling followed. The parking is superseded rather than deleted: it was correct on the evidence it had — three field reports that month mentioned environment compliance zero times — and the record of why it was taken is worth as much as the record of why it ended.

WHY THE WHOLE LEG AND NOT THE WRITE SIDE. The deliberation had already argued this against option (b): a write side without a read side is the unread-property failure, and this project measured that failure three separate times on the day of the ruling. So the constructor, the four edges and the two detectors land together or not at all.

WHAT IS STILL OPEN and deliberately not decided here: whether QualityGate should get a constructor or be retired. It is read by nothing, has never held an instance, and its own extraction hint says the workflow authors it rather than a person. The agent's recommendation was retirement rather than a constructor; Anthony has not ruled.
properties.name: The environment compliance parking is lifted — its own stated condition, a real request, was met
properties.rationale:
Kept as its own node for the reason the parking gives about itself: a ruling a machine reads and a deliberation a person reads are different artifacts, and a lift is a third. The parked node keeps its id and its identity, and its status now says it was superseded rather than that it never happened.

The lift is also evidence about the mechanism rather than only about this feature. A parking that STATES ITS OWN REVERSAL CONDITION is a genuinely cheap way to defer, because the condition can later be checked by anyone rather than re-argued from scratch. That is worth remembering the next time a domain looks unused and somebody reaches for retirement instead.
